entities.summary: The Hazrat Khizr Mosque is a historical monument in Samarkand, Uzbekistan ; associated with the name of the legendary Islamic prophet Khizr. The building was erected on the site of an ancient mosque. The monument is located opposite the Shah-i-Zinda complex on a hill. In 2018, the mausoleum of the First President of the Republic of Uzbekistan Islam Karimov was opened in the territory of the mosque. Hazrat-Hyzr Mosque is a mosque in Asia, established in 1919. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
